title: Employers' Compliance with Mandatory Provision of Itemised Payslips
what_it_is: Employers' Compliance with Mandatory Provision of Itemised Payslips

sections.label: Employers told to rectify practices
sections.summary: Proactive inspections led to 1,200 employers being formally informed to rectify their practices.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Through proactive inspections on employers, another 1,200 employers were formally informed to rectify their practices.

sections.label: Guidebooks and payslip templates distributed
sections.summary: Guidebooks on complying with requirements and payslip templates have been distributed to about 180,000 employers so far.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Guidebooks on complying with the requirements and templates for the payslips have been distributed to about 180,000 employers so far.

sections.label: Reasons for contravening regulation
sections.summary: A common reason given by those found to have contravened the regulation is a lack of resources or expertise to implement itemised payslips.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: On the first question, one of the most common reasons given to us in terms of those who are found to have contravened the regulation is that they have a lack of resources or expertise on the ground to implement itemised payslips.

sections.label: No back-printing requirement
sections.summary: MOM does not currently require back-printing of payslips.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Second, with regard to whether MOM requires back-printing of payslips, at this point, we do not have that requirement.

sections.label: Itemised payslip issuance and enforcement
sections.summary: MOM's survey found 95% of private establishments with at least 25 employees provided itemised payslips in 2017, and enforcement will be strengthened.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: On the last item, the proportion of employers who issue itemised payslips, based on MOM's survey since its inception in 2016, the vast majority or 95% of private establishments provide itemised payslips to their employees in 2017.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The survey was done for private establishments with at least 25 employees.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: This is where MOM will continue to reinforce the requirement in our communication to employers through various channels, including proactive inspections. as part of our WorkRight Initiative.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: But going forward, we will also strengthen our enforcement against establishments that fail to issue itemised payslips.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Establishments which persistently fail to rectify their practices will be issued with relevant penalties.
